model_B_corollary.SRC10_statement: model B replaces the cavity flameholder by a constant-cross-sectional tube with the same diameter as the isolator
model_B_corollary.SRC11_statement: parallel experiments replace the cavity flameholder by a constant-area cross-section tube with the same length dimensions as the cavity

coordinate_records.station_3_definition: isolator exit / combustor inlet / most-upstream fuel injection

evidence_boundary: The model-B constant-area replacement and its 35 mm diameter are source-backed.
The 42 mm injector-to-cavity-leading-edge distance is source-backed and remains constant-area in the corresponding model-B location.
The phrase 'same length dimensions as the cavity' is not converted into a numerical replacement-tube length without an unambiguous Fig. 1/Fig. 2 dimensional interpretation.

The 2 degree cone angle is retained as a raw source descriptor; whether it is a wall half-angle or included cone angle must be frozen from the original geometry figure before constructing a formal area profile.
No formal validation geometry is promoted until the transition from the 35 mm constant tube to the 2 degree diverging section is unambiguously located.
next_geometry_evidence_priority: Recover the original dimensioned model-B geometry figure at sufficient resolution to freeze replacement-tube axial extent, divergence start, and 2-degree angle convention.
